messages:
Hannah (People Ops): Quick launchpad thread for new manager Luca Chen starting Mon. I built a compact week0->week1 checklist tailored to managers (tech + people ops + finance). Please add missing steps. TL;DR below. :rocket:
Luca Chen: Thanks! Couple quicks: laptop day0? GitHub org + SSH? expense card? Also would love an infra buddy to shadow the deploy flow.
Omar (IT): If procurement ticket is in by Thu we can image and ship laptop for Day0. We handle Okta/GSuite invites and GitHub org invites. Please use the ticket template below and paste SSH pubkey when you get GitHub invite.
Omar (IT): ```Title: New manager device & access - Luca Chen
Start: 2026-09-07
Team: Eng - Runtime
Device: Macbook Pro 14 / Existing: no
Needed: Okta + GSuite, GitHub org (write), AWS staging read, Vault read, KMS view?
Manager approver: Marta (Infra)
```
Priya (Finance): For expense card: email finance@redwood.com with headcount code and manager approval. Virtual card same-week after approvals; physical card 5-7 days. Include estimated monthly spend.
Marta (Infra): Happy to buddy week1 for infra walkthroughs. Day2 I'll demo staging + deploy flow and show the demo-pool fast path. For demo pools <12h file request in #eng-infra with purpose, region, concurrency, retention hours and I'll fast-track.
Hannah (People Ops): Launchpad compact checklist: Preboard (3 days): procurement ticket, finance headcount note, Okta invite. Day0 (eve): confirm device tracking # or pickup, calendar invites created. Day1: 30m manager 1:1 + access verification (Okta/GitHub/AWS), security & SSO quickstart, enroll MFA. Day2: infra buddy walkthrough + staging demo, request demo pool if needed. Day3: pair on triage + meet direct reports in 1:1s. Day4: draft 30/60/90 and tag manager + infra for feedback. Day5: kickoff first ownership task and week1 retro.
Luca Chen: I'll paste SSH pubkey after GitHub invite. Also can someone share a concise 30/60/90 sample that shows measurable outcomes?
Hannah (People Ops): Sample lean 30/60/90 (one-liners):
- 30d: Ramp  Meet TLs, read runbooks, merge first small PR, complete infra access checklist.
- 60d: Deliver a small feature or bugfix end-to-end, run a post-deploy check, own one recurring oncall rota.
- 90d: Ship a measurable win (e.g., reduce median tail latency by X% on a path, or reduce infra cost by Y% for demo pools). Tag metrics and owner.
Omar (IT): Okta invite sent to luca.chen@redwood.com  enroll MFA and check GSuite. GitHub invite pending manager approval. If device imaging fails DM me with screenshot.
onboard-bot: Calendar event created: "Manager Launchpad - Day 0" invited: luca.chen@redwood.com
Luca Chen: MFA done. GitHub invite showed up. Thanks Marta for buddy offer. One last Q: who signs off KMS/prod creds?
Marta (Infra): Prod/KMS requires written justification and manager approver + infra review. Add justification to the infra access PR and tag me. We'll keep staging separate for week1 work.
Priya (Finance): Luca - send headcount code + estimated monthly card spend to finance@redwood.com and cc your manager. We'll queue virtual card after approvals.
Hannah (People Ops): Great thread 44f I'll chase Procurement + IT for device ETA and close the checklist once items are green. Luca - drop your 30/60/90 draft here when ready and tag Marta + your manager. Welcome aboard! :tada:
